titles: "누가 흘렸는지 밝혀내라" | 돈을 빌려준 중국이 에콰도르에서 10억 달러 조건을 감추게 한 이유 | 계약서 100장에 똑같이 박힌 한 줄과 하나씩 뒤집히는 장부
"48시간 안에 나가라" | 돈줄을 쥔 중국이 니제르에서 대표 3명을 사흘 만에 잃은 이유 | 계약서에 심어 둔 조항과 되돌아오지 않는 돈

meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above, rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms; every other surface that would carry writing shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, never invented English words and never fake Chinese characters. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 2016년 5월 23일 중국국가개발은행이 에콰도르에 보낸 색출 요구 서한(verified-data 장면·일화). 채권자의 손이 실제로 채무국 서류에 닿게 해 '지시했다'를 물리화했다. 국가 대 국가 축이므로 양쪽 다 국기 구체. 표정 온도를 갈랐다 — 중국은 실눈 미소, 에콰도르는 경악.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished office floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — stands on the right in a dark business suit, its eyes curved into thin confident slits and its mouth a small smug upward hook, one black gloved hand pressing a red-stamped letter flat and sliding it across a desk into the other sphere's chest. On the left a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Ecuadorian flag — a horizontal yellow band of double width above blue above red — recoils with its eyes blown wide and white, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, mouth open in a shocked O, three big sweat droplets flying off its surface and shake lines around it. Between and behind them a crisply detailed oil pumpjack and a run of pipeline valves rise in the middle ground. The letter's cover carries the Korean Hangul label "기밀유지" printed large and clear; every other line on the letter is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Blurred refinery skyline and dusk sky behind, red warning glow raking across both spheres.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 교차 디폴트가 작동한 순간 — 아르헨티나가 댐을 되돌리려 하자 상관없는 벨그라노 화물철도 대출이 취소 통보를 받았다. '서류상 한 줄로 묶여 있었다'를 거대한 쇠사슬 하나로 그려 글자 없이 읽히게 했다. 중국 구체가 사슬을 당기는 접촉으로 힘의 방향을 명시.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain flat ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Dominating the centre of the upper frame, a massive concrete hydroelectric dam wall on the left and a heavy freight locomotive on the right are lashed together by one enormous rust-red steel chain rendered in crisp mechanical detail, the chain running taut between the spillway gate and the locomotive coupler. A glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — floats large in the upper right in a dark business suit, eyes half-lidded and bored, mouth a flat unimpressed line, both black gloved hands hauling back on the chain. Small in the lower left of the upper five-eighths, a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Argentine flag — horizontal light blue, white and light blue bands with a golden sun face in the centre — stumbles backwards, eyes brimming and squeezed, mouth trembling open, shake lines and a tiny dust puff behind it. A steel shipping container beside the locomotive carries the Korean Hangul label "교차 담보" stencilled large and clear on its side; every other stencil mark on the container is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Blurred mountain valley and cold blue sky behind, sparks flying where the chain grinds.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 나이지리아 하원이 철도 대출 계약서에서 제8조 1항(주권면제를 철회 불가능하게 포기)을 발견한 순간. 조항 한 줄이 나라의 면제권을 가져간다는 이 영상의 명제를 표정 하나로 읽히게 했다. 붉은 원+화살표는 앵커의 강제 지목 장치를 1~6번에도 이어 쓴 것.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth pale stone floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Filling most of the upper frame in extreme close-up, a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Nigerian flag — three vertical bands of green, white, green — holds an open loan contract up right in front of its own face with both small black gloved hands, its eyes bulged with pupils shrunk to pinpricks, eyebrows driven into a hard V, mouth hanging open, a single bead of sweat rolling down the glossy surface and shake lines radiating outward. A hard red circle with an arrow is drawn over one single line of the open contract, forcing the eye onto it. Behind it, much smaller and slightly out of focus in the upper right, a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — watches with narrowed knowing eyes and a small closed smirk. The contract's cover page carries the Korean Hangul label "제8조" printed large and clear; every other line of the document is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Blurred parliamentary chamber benches and warm lamp glow in the background.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 3절 '계약서 100장에 똑같이 박힌 한 줄'을 그대로 이행. 100장이 부채꼴로 펼쳐지고 모든 장 같은 자리에 같은 붉은 줄이 반복되는 그림 자체가 증거다(AidData 24개국 100건). 도장을 찍는 손동작으로 '누가 이걸 설계했는가'를 명시.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished desktop — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A colossal fan of a hundred identical printed loan contracts sweeps across the whole upper frame in a wide arc, each page crisply detailed, and on every single page the exact same single line sits at the same position marked in hard red, the red line repeating across the entire fan like a stamped pattern. A glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — stands large at the right of the fan in a dark business suit, eyes curved into sharp confident crescents, mouth a wide closed satisfied smile, one black gloved hand slamming a big red seal down onto the topmost page, red ink spraying in a small burst. A few loose contract pages and a scatter of red seal impressions float in the air around the fan with motion trails. The topmost cover carries the Korean Hangul label "대출 계약서" printed large and clear; every other line on every page is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Blurred bank vault interior and warm gold light behind.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 1절 인용구 '누가 흘렸는지 밝혀내라'의 이행 컷. 빚의 조건을 국민에게 알렸다는 이유로 채권자에게 색출을 지시받은 자리 — 두 손으로 제 입을 틀어막은 구체 하나로 '말하면 안 된다'는 썸네일 카피(1순위)와 정확히 맞물린다. 상대는 손가락만 화면에 들여 압박의 방향을 남긴다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth grey interrogation-room floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Filling most of the upper frame in extreme close-up, a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Ecuadorian flag — a horizontal yellow band of double width above blue above red — clamps both small black gloved hands hard over its own drawn mouth, eyes stretched enormous and white with tiny trembling pupils, two vertical sweat streaks running down the glossy surface, shake lines all around it, a single harsh overhead spotlight carving it out of the dark. Entering from the right edge only, one large black gloved hand and a sliver of a glossy sphere wrapped in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — points a rigid accusing finger straight at it. Behind them a crisply detailed video monitor on a rolling stand shows a paused frame of grainy footage. The monitor's bezel label reads the Korean Hangul "유출 조사" printed large and clear; every other readout on the screen is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Blurred dark office wall and cold blue rim light in the background.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 부제 '하나씩 뒤집히는 장부'의 이행 컷 — 2025년 3월 니제르가 중국 대표 3명에게 48시간 출국을 통보한 사건. 여기서 표정 온도가 뒤집힌다: 이번엔 채무국이 분노, 중국이 땀. 총사업비 70억 달러 송유관이 배경 피사체로 '무엇을 잃는 판인가'에 답한다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain flat desert ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. On the left a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Nigerien flag — horizontal orange, white and green bands with an orange disc in the centre — stands in military uniform, eyebrows slammed into a hard V, eyes blazing and narrowed, mouth open in a shout with teeth clenched, tearing a loan contract clean in two with both black gloved hands, torn paper fragments flying between the two characters. On the right a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — backs away in a dark business suit, its mouth pulled into a wide flat O of dismay, eyes darting sideways away from the viewer, four sweat droplets flying, shake lines around it, one black gloved hand white-knuckling the handle of a rolling suitcase held at mid height. Between them rise the crisply detailed pipe racks and burn stack of an oil refinery. A steel notice board on the refinery fence carries the Korean Hangul label "계약 해지" printed large and clear; every other line on the board is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Blurred sunset sky and heat haze behind.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 돈을 빌려준 쪽이 화면을 혼자 차지한 채 겁먹고 있다. [남김] ① 좌우 분할 없이 중국 구체가 화면 단독 지배 ② 붉은 원+화살표로 핵심 오브젝트 강제 지목 ③ 하단 3/8을 텍스트 밴드 자리로 비움(앵커의 하단 35~40% 2줄 계층형 텍스트 위치 계승) ④ 정면 아이레벨, 구체가 관객 쪽을 본다. [바꿈] ① 핵심 피사체(빨간 원 안의 빈 크레인 조종석 → 도장 찍힌 계약서 뭉치) ② 배경(뿌연 회색 공사장 → 어두운 집무실과 서류철 벽) ③ 부속 요소(짐 지고 줄지어 걸어 나가는 작은 중국기 인물 행렬 → 밀려나 있는 빈 의자 하나). 구체는 중국으로 3장 고정 — [모순]을 무명 주체로 바꿔 읽으면 '돈을 빌려준 쪽'이라는 주어가 증발한다. 거리감은 셋 중 가장 넓은 컷. 정면 대결 구도는 [남김]①(단독 지배)과 정면으로 충돌하므로 계승 3장에서는 쓰지 않았고, 우리 쪽 구체 조항은 한국이 등장하지 않는 제3국 서사라 미적용.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished office floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Wide shot of a dark state office, no second country anywhere in the picture. A single glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller yellow stars — dominates the right side of the upper frame in a dark business suit, facing the camera straight on at eye level, its eyes blown huge and white with tiny pupils, mouth hanging open, eyebrows shoved up, four fat sweat droplets flying off the glossy surface and shake lines around its whole body, no hands raised. On the left, large in the middle ground, a thick stack of loan contracts sits on a lacquered desk under a red seal, and a hard red circle with a red arrow is drawn over that stack, forcing the eye onto it exactly as the reference did with an empty crane cab. One empty chair stands pushed back from the desk at an angle. Behind everything, floor-to-ceiling shelves of document binders recede out of focus. The nearest binder spine carries the Korean Hangul label "비공개" printed large and clear; every other spine and every contract line is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cold grey window light and a red warning glow across the wall.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 돈을 빌려준 쪽이 화면을 혼자 차지한 채 겁먹고 있다. [남김] 7번과 동일한 4개(단독 지배 / 붉은 원+화살표 지목 / 하단 3/8 텍스트 자리 / 정면 아이레벨 응시). [바꿈] ① 핵심 피사체(빈 크레인 조종석 → 잔액이 멈춘 상환 장부와 계좌 단말) ② 광원·색온도(뿌연 회색 주광 → 아래에서 올라오는 붉은 경광 반사) ③ 손동작(짐 지고 걸어 나가는 행렬 → 이마를 짚은 검은 장갑 손). 근거는 verified-data 3-3절 — 원금은 안 깎고 버티다 결국 못 받게 된 국면. 구체는 중국 고정, 거리감은 가슴 위.
